blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — Eastern Samar Gov. Ralph Vincent “RV” Evardone thanked President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. for his commitment to provide additional funding to improve the delivery of healthcare services in the province during the President’s visit to the newly reconstructed Felipe Abrigo Memorial Hospital (FAMH) in Guiuan on Friday, Sept. 25. Evardone said Marcos had committed an additional P100 million for the improvement of the province’s four district hospitals, on top of the P200 million earlier released for the FAMH. “This will really be a big help to our people in Eastern Samar,” Evardone said.
